title: Chemical recycling: a new toolbox for materials recycling in industry and the application of the mass balance chain-of-custody approach
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00505A, Perspective
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Christian Krueger, Ivana Krkljuš, Jenny Reuber
Increasing circularity in chemical value chains is still critical. This paper assesses the technical potential, and economic implications of chemical recycling and mass balance chain-of-custody model to scale the use of waste-derived feedstocks.
